articles.title: Welcome to Jupiter's Realm: A Gas Giant with Secrets and Storms
articles.summary: Jupiter isn't just the biggest planet—it's a mini solar system with 70 moons, a centuries-old hurricane, and radiation that would fry a spacecraft. Some astronomers even call it a failed star. Here's why this gas giant is so fascinating.

articles.title: Australia: Land of Extremes, from Deadly Snakes to the World's Largest Rock
articles.summary: Australia is a continent-sized country where one-third is desert, yet it's rich in unique wildlife and diverse cultures. It boasts the world's largest rock, 516 national parks, and some of the planet's most venomous creatures. Here's what makes it so extraordinary.

articles.title: French Open Media Boycott: Top Players Unite in Pay Dispute
articles.summary: In an unprecedented show of unity, tennis stars like Aryna Sabalenka and Jannik Sinner limited their press time at the French Open to protest prize money distribution. The 'work-to-rule' action signals growing frustration among players who feel ignored by Grand Slam organizers.
